instruction: I use VLC for basic video playback and don't need any extensions. The automatic extension loading is slowing down VLC startup. Can you disable the automatic loading of extensions?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's automatic extension loading. The evaluator checks if the 'qt-autoload-extensions' setting in VLC configuration is set to 0 (disabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable automatic extension loading in VLC
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-specific paths
Expected value '0' is semantically correct for disabling the feature (default is '1')
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_autoload_extensions')
Good edge case handling: default value assumption, comment line filtering, type conversion
Postconfig correctly kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are read and applied
Complete coverage: instruction asks to disable extensions, evaluator checks exactly that setting
Logic will work correctly at runtime: reads config file, parses for setting, compares value
